comment_text.value:
Very cool, great work and awesome story of how you all preserved to get to this point.

Are you thinking at all about security certifications to more easily be approved with, or sell subscriptions to, enterprise companies?

I’d love a pair but realistically I couldn’t use them with work unless it was an approved vendor; we use Wispr Flow though so I imagine being on a similar plane to them would suffice.

story_title.value: Show HN: Subvocal – Talk to your computer without making noise
